prior_family_ledger.purpose: Conservative strategy-family accounting for selection-bias review. This ledger does not reconstruct undocumented experiments.

families.pbo_blocker: Not every choice has a comparable return matrix across identical folds, and any experiments before the repository ledger are unknown.

records.interpretation: Original holdout result; later comparison makes the currently selected strategy part of a wider family-selection process.

blockers: All historical parameter/search choices are not reconstructed.
Four comparison arms are not the six-plus historical economic candidates.
IID DSR does not correct serial dependence; CSCV is not a new chronological holdout.
Reused history and modeled fills cannot establish executable alpha.

first_principles.payer: ETF exposure; incremental timing edge unproven
first_principles.decision: Do not change frozen candidate or allocate capital from subset diagnostics.
